hero.subtitle: WOB reads your WhatsApp chats, separates real leads from noise, spots the sales, and reports them back to TikTok and Meta, so your campaigns learn to find buyers instead of clicks.

stage.aria: Animation: ad clicks fall into a funnel, WhatsApp chats are sorted into trash, qualified leads and sales, and a signal is sent back to TikTok and Meta.

problem.title: Your ad dashboard can't see the chat.
problem.body: TikTok and Meta count the click and stop there. What happens next lives in WhatsApp, where a hundred messages can hide a handful of buyers. So the algorithm keeps buying more of whatever clicks.

how.title: Three steps. Then it runs itself.

steps.title: Scan the QR
steps.body: Link your WhatsApp the same way you link WhatsApp Web. You keep chatting from your phone like always.

steps.title: Connect your ads
steps.body: Plug in your TikTok and Meta ad accounts. WOB matches each conversation to the campaign it came from.

steps.title: WOB reports the sales back
steps.body: Qualified leads and orders go back to TikTok and Meta as conversion events, so their algorithms chase buyers.

demo.title: Same budget. Very different truth.
demo.body: Ad dashboards rank campaigns by clicks. WOB ranks them by who actually became a lead and who actually paid, with cost per qualified lead and cost per client for every campaign.
demo.verdictA: Looks like the winner in the ad dashboard.

features.title: Everything between the click and the cash.

items.title: Lead sorting
items.body: Every conversation is labeled: not a lead, real, qualified or client. No more scrolling to guess.

items.title: Sale detection
items.body: WOB recognizes when a chat turns into an order and records it against the right campaign.

items.title: Signals back to the ads
items.body: Qualified leads and sales are sent to TikTok's Events API and Meta's Conversions API.

items.title: Real cost metrics
items.body: Cost per qualified lead and cost per client, per campaign, next to the numbers you already know.

items.title: Your phone, your WhatsApp
items.body: Connect with a QR scan. Nothing changes for you or your customers.

items.title: Built for Arabic and English
items.body: Understands both languages, and the whole app works right-to-left.

items.q: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?
items.a: No. You link your existing WhatsApp by scanning a QR code, and you keep using it on your phone as usual.

items.q: What does WOB send to TikTok and Meta?
items.a: Conversion events for leads that WOB marks as qualified and for sales, through TikTok's Events API and Meta's Conversions API, so the platforms can optimize toward them.
Yes. WOB works with Arabic and English conversations, and the app itself is available in both languages.
No. It's an optional add-on. Lead sorting, sale detection and reporting work without it.

items.q: Can an agency manage several clients?
items.a: Yes. The Agency plan lets you add many clients, each with their own WhatsApp and ad accounts, and work on them as a team.
